sql: DELETE FROM attachment_derivatives WHERE attachment_id=?
DELETE FROM attachment_jobs WHERE updated_at<? AND status IN ('succeeded','failed','cancelled')
DELETE FROM attachment_legal_holds WHERE attachment_id=?
DELETE FROM attachment_operations WHERE idempotency_key=? AND operation='prompt-reservation' AND phase='reserved'
DELETE FROM attachment_operations WHERE updated_at<? AND phase='committed' AND operation!='prompt-reservation'
DELETE FROM backup_blob_pins WHERE backup_id=?
DELETE FROM backup_runs WHERE id=?
DELETE FROM blobs WHERE sha256=?
DELETE FROM tus_uploads WHERE expires_at<=? AND upload_id IN (SELECT id FROM attachments WHERE blob_sha256 IS NOT NULL)
DELETE FROM tus_uploads WHERE upload_id=?
INSERT INTO attachment_audit_events( attachment_id,event_type,provider,model_id,session_id,request_id,created_at ) VALUES(?,'agent-delivery',?,?,?,?,?)
INSERT INTO attachment_jobs( id,attachment_id,job_type,input_json,status,attempts,max_attempts, available_at,created_at,updated_at ) VALUES(?,?,'cleanup','{}','pending',0,4,?,?,?)

INSERT INTO attachment_jobs(id,attachment_id,job_type,processor_id,processor_version,input_json,status,attempts,max_attempts,available_at,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(?,?,'process',?,?,?,'pending',0,3,?,?,?)
INSERT INTO attachment_legal_holds(attachment_id,reason,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?) ON CONFLICT(attachment_id) DO UPDATE SET reason=excluded.reason
INSERT INTO attachment_operations(id,idempotency_key,fingerprint,attachment_id,operation,phase,result_json,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,'delete','cleanup-pending',?,?,?)
INSERT INTO attachment_operations(id,idempotency_key,fingerprint,attachment_id,operation,phase,result_json,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,'retry','committed',?,?,?)

INSERT INTO attachment_operations(id,idempotency_key,fingerprint,attachment_id,operation,phase,staging_key,expected_size,created_at,updated_at,expires_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?, 'upload-create','initiated',?,?,?,?,?)
INSERT INTO attachment_operations(id,idempotency_key,fingerprint,operation,phase,result_json,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(?,?,?,'prompt-reservation','reserved',?,?,?)
INSERT INTO attachments(id,workspace_id,owner_id,original_name,declared_mime,byte_size,status,revision,created_at,updated_at,expires_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?, 'initiated',1,?,?,?)
INSERT INTO backup_blob_pins(backup_id,blob_sha256) VALUES(?,?)
INSERT INTO backup_runs(id,status,database_snapshot_key,manifest_key,created_at) VALUES(?,'preparing',?,?,?)
INSERT INTO blobs(sha256,storage_key,byte_size,state,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?,'published',?) ON CONFLICT(sha256) DO UPDATE SET state='published'
INSERT INTO tus_uploads(upload_id,upload_length,upload_offset,metadata_json,staging_key,expires_at,updated_at) VALUES(?,?,0,?,?,?,?)
INSERT OR IGNORE INTO attachment_chunks(attachment_id,derivative_id,ordinal,source_locator_json,text,character_count,token_estimate) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?)

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO attachment_derivatives(id,attachment_id,kind,processor_id,processor_version,source_sha256,mime_type,byte_size,sha256,storage_key,width,height,page_from,page_to,metadata_json,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)
INSERT OR IGNORE INTO message_attachments(session_id,entry_id,attachment_id,ordinal,request_id,presentation_json,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?)

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM attachments WHERE blob_sha256=? AND status!='deleted') + (SELECT count(*) FROM attachment_derivatives WHERE sha256=?) + (SELECT count(*) FROM backup_blob_pins WHERE blob_sha256=?) AS count

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM tus_uploads u JOIN attachments a ON a.id=u.upload_id WHERE a.owner_id=? AND a.status IN ('initiated','uploading')) AS owner_uploads, (SELECT count(*) FROM tus_uploads u JOIN attachments a ON a.id=u.upload_id WHERE a.workspace_id=? AND a.status IN ('initiated','uploading')) AS workspace_uploads, (SELECT count(*) FROM attachment_jobs j JOIN attachments a ON a.id=j.attachment_id WHERE a.workspace_id=? AND j.status IN ('pending','running')) AS workspace_pending_jobs
SELECT * FROM attachments WHERE id=?
SELECT * FROM tus_uploads WHERE upload_id = ?
SELECT 1
SELECT 1 FROM attachment_legal_holds WHERE attachment_id=?
SELECT 1 FROM attachment_operations WHERE attachment_id=? AND operation='upload-create' AND expires_at<=? LIMIT 1
SELECT 1 FROM backup_runs WHERE status='verified' AND completed_at>=? LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT attachment_id FROM attachment_operations WHERE operation='delete' AND phase IN ('cleanup-pending','cleaning') AND attachment_id IS NOT NULL

SELECT MIN(CASE WHEN status='pending' THEN available_at ELSE lease_expires_at END) AS deadline FROM attachment_jobs WHERE attempts < max_attempts AND (status='pending' OR (status='running' AND lease_owner<>?))

SELECT a.id,a.workspace_id,a.revision FROM attachments a WHERE a.expires_at IS NOT NULL AND a.expires_at<=? AND a.status IN ('ready','failed') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM message_attachments ma WHERE ma.attachment_id=a.id) ORDER BY a.expires_at LIMIT ?
SELECT attachment_id,phase,staging_key,target_storage_key,expected_size,expected_sha256 FROM attachment_operations WHERE operation='upload-create' AND phase IN ('initiated','publishing')

SELECT c.attachment_id,c.source_locator_json,c.text FROM attachment_chunks_fts f JOIN attachment_chunks c ON c.id=f.rowid WHERE attachment_chunks_fts MATCH ? AND c.attachment_id IN (${placeholders}) ORDER BY rank LIMIT ?
SELECT fingerprint,attachment_id,operation,result_json FROM attachment_operations WHERE idempotency_key=?
SELECT id FROM attachment_derivatives WHERE attachment_id=? AND kind=? AND processor_id=? AND processor_version=? AND source_sha256=?
SELECT id FROM attachment_jobs WHERE attachment_id=? AND job_type='cleanup' AND status IN ('pending','running','succeeded') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM backup_runs WHERE status='verified' ORDER BY completed_at DESC LIMIT -1 OFFSET ?

SELECT id,attachment_id,job_type,input_json,attempts,max_attempts FROM attachment_jobs WHERE attempts < max_attempts AND ((status='pending' AND available_at<=?) OR (status='running' AND lease_expires_at<=?)) ORDER BY available_at,created_at LIMIT 1
SELECT id,mime_type,byte_size,sha256,storage_key FROM attachment_derivatives WHERE attachment_id=? AND kind=? ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id,status FROM attachment_jobs WHERE attachment_id=? AND job_type='cleanup' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT idempotency_key,result_json FROM attachment_operations WHERE operation='prompt-reservation' AND phase='reserved'
SELECT ma.entry_id,ma.presentation_json,a.status FROM message_attachments ma JOIN attachments a ON a.id=ma.attachment_id WHERE ma.session_id=? ORDER BY ma.entry_id,ma.ordinal
SELECT sha256,storage_key,byte_size FROM blobs WHERE state='published'
SELECT sha256,storage_key,byte_size FROM blobs WHERE state='published' ORDER BY sha256
SELECT staging_key FROM tus_uploads
SELECT storage_key FROM attachment_derivatives WHERE attachment_id=?
SELECT storage_key FROM blobs WHERE sha256=? AND state='published'
SELECT u.upload_id FROM tus_uploads u JOIN attachments a ON a.id=u.upload_id WHERE u.expires_at <= ? AND a.blob_sha256 IS NULL
UPDATE attachment_jobs SET lease_expires_at=?,updated_at=? WHERE id=? AND status='running' AND lease_owner=?
UPDATE attachment_jobs SET status='cancelled',lease_owner=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL,updated_at=? WHERE attachment_id=? AND job_type='process' AND status IN ('pending','running')
UPDATE attachment_jobs SET status='cancelled',updated_at=? WHERE attachment_id=? AND status='pending'
UPDATE attachment_jobs SET status='pending',attempts=0,available_at=?,lease_owner=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL, last_error_code=NULL,result_json=NULL,updated_at=? WHERE id=?
UPDATE attachment_jobs SET status='running',attempts=attempts+1,lease_owner=?,lease_expires_at=?,updated_at=? WHERE id=? AND attempts=?
UPDATE attachment_jobs SET status='succeeded',lease_owner=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL,result_json=?,updated_at=? WHERE id=? AND status='running' AND lease_owner=?
UPDATE attachment_jobs SET status=?,available_at=?,lease_owner=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL,last_error_code=?,updated_at=? WHERE id=? AND status='running' AND lease_owner=?
UPDATE attachment_operations SET phase='cleaning',updated_at=? WHERE attachment_id=? AND operation='delete' AND phase='cleanup-pending'
UPDATE attachment_operations SET phase='cleanup-pending',updated_at=? WHERE attachment_id=? AND operation='delete' AND phase='held'
UPDATE attachment_operations SET phase='committed',target_storage_key=?,expected_sha256=?,result_json=?,updated_at=? WHERE attachment_id=? AND operation='upload-create'
UPDATE attachment_operations SET phase='committed',updated_at=? WHERE attachment_id=? AND operation='delete' AND phase IN ('cleanup-pending','cleaning')
UPDATE attachment_operations SET phase='committed',updated_at=? WHERE idempotency_key=?
UPDATE attachment_operations SET phase='held',updated_at=? WHERE attachment_id=? AND operation='delete' AND phase IN ('cleanup-pending','cleaning')

UPDATE attachment_operations SET phase='publishing',target_storage_key=?,expected_sha256=?,expected_size=?,updated_at=? WHERE attachment_id=? AND operation='upload-create' AND phase IN ('initiated','publishing')
UPDATE attachments SET blob_sha256=NULL,updated_at=? WHERE id=?
UPDATE attachments SET blob_sha256=NULL,updated_at=? WHERE id=? AND blob_sha256=? AND status='rejected'
UPDATE attachments SET expires_at=NULL,updated_at=? WHERE id IN (SELECT attachment_id FROM message_attachments WHERE session_id=? AND entry_id=?)
UPDATE attachments SET sha256=?,blob_sha256=?,byte_size=?,status='verifying',revision=revision+1,updated_at=? WHERE id=? AND status IN ('initiated','uploading','verifying')
UPDATE attachments SET status='deleted',deleted_at=?,updated_at=?,revision=revision+1 WHERE id=? AND status!='deleted'
UPDATE attachments SET status='deleted',deleted_at=?,updated_at=?,revision=revision+1,failure_code=NULL,failure_retryable=0 WHERE id=? AND workspace_id=? AND revision=? AND status!='deleted'

UPDATE attachments SET status='failed',failure_code='ATTACHMENT_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE',failure_retryable=1, updated_at=?,revision=revision+1 WHERE blob_sha256=? AND status NOT IN ('deleted','rejected','failed')

UPDATE attachments SET status='processing',failure_code=NULL,failure_retryable=0,updated_at=?,revision=revision+1 WHERE id=? AND workspace_id=? AND revision=? AND status='failed' AND failure_retryable=1

UPDATE attachments SET status='ready',presentation_kind=?,ready_at=?,expires_at=?,updated_at=?,evidence_json=?,revision=revision+1,failure_code=NULL,failure_retryable=0 WHERE id=? AND status='processing'
UPDATE attachments SET status='uploading',revision=revision+1,updated_at=? WHERE id=? AND status IN ('initiated','uploading')

UPDATE attachments SET status=?,detected_mime=COALESCE(?,detected_mime),classification=COALESCE(?,classification),presentation_kind=COALESCE(?,presentation_kind),failure_code=?,failure_retryable=?,policy_version=COALESCE(?,policy_version),rule_version=COALESCE(?,rule_version),evidence_json=COALESCE(?,evidence_json),ready_at=CASE WHEN ?='ready' THEN ? ELSE ready_at END,deleted_at=CASE WHEN ?='deleted' THEN ? ELSE deleted_at END,expires_at=COALESCE(?,expires_at),revision=revision+1,updated_at=? WHERE id=? AND revision=? AND status IN (${placeholders})
UPDATE backup_runs SET status='copying' WHERE id=? AND status='preparing'
UPDATE backup_runs SET status=?,completed_at=? WHERE id=?
UPDATE blobs SET state='deleting' WHERE sha256=?
UPDATE tus_uploads SET upload_offset=?,updated_at=? WHERE upload_id=? AND upload_offset=? AND ? <= upload_length
